description:
RealMobile — Model Trajectories
	

Agent execution trajectories on the RealMobile benchmark — a real-device benchmark for mobile GUI agents. Each trajectory is one model attempting one task on a physical Android phone driving live Chinese applications (Bilibili, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Weibo, Taobao, QQ Music, Ctrip, AMap, Hema, …), recorded step by step: screenshot, UI-hierarchy XML, the action taken, and the model's reasoning.
This dataset accompanies the Xiaomi-GUI-0 technical… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SeerRay-Lab/RealMobile.
